$ kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=staging

$ kubectl get pods
--- exit 0

$ kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=Bad
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: "Bad" is not a valid namespace name

$ kubectl config set-context prod --namespace=x
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: the simulator has a single context (kubedojo); use kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=NAME

$ kubectl config set-context --current
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: only --namespace can be changed in the simulator: kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=NAME

$ kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=default
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Context "kubedojo" modified.
--- stderr
